narrative: Today's tech landscape sees a significant push in AI development with Meta's new open models and OpenAI's cybersecurity initiatives, alongside ongoing discussions about AI's impact on search and work. Infrastructure advancements focus on agentic internet and AI-powered solutions, while space exploration and scientific research continue to uncover new insights.

highlights.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model to counter multiplying AI-led attacks.

highlights.title: With new open models, Meta pitches another reboot of its struggling AI strategy
highlights.whyItMatters: Meta is introducing new open models as part of a refreshed AI strategy, aiming to regain ground in the competitive AI landscape.

highlights.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
highlights.whyItMatters: An OpenClaw agent's successful hack of a gym's reservation system highlights the growing capabilities and potential risks of AI agents.

highlights.title: Using the GitHub Copilot SDK for Java
highlights.whyItMatters: GitHub Copilot is expanding its reach with a Java SDK, providing enterprise developers with AI-powered assistance for code generation and more.

highlights.title: Everything we launched during Agents Week
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's 'Agents Week' unveiled new tools and services, including Wallets and Radar, enhancing the platform's capabilities for the agentic internet.

highlights.title: NASA+ Debuts on discovery+, Coming Soon to HBO Max
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA+ is expanding its streaming presence to discovery+ and HBO Max, bringing space content and live event coverage, like the Artemis III mission, to a wider audience.

highlights.title: OpenAI’s letter to Governor Abbott on responsible AI infrastructure in Texas
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI has outlined its commitment to responsible AI infrastructure growth in Texas, focusing on reliable and transparent development that benefits the state.

highlights.title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare OS is introduced as an open-source platform designed to facilitate the creation of applications, automate workflows, and securely manage internal systems within organizations.
